div.div:
عَسْكَرَةٌ Difficulty, distress, or adversity: (S, O, K:) and dearth, scarcity, or drought. (K.) Tarafeh says, “ظَلَّ فِى عَسْكَرَةٍ مِنْ حُبِّهَا
” i. e., He became in a state of difficulty, or distress, by reason of love of her. (S, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
